_note: Rule-driven 'Before you deploy' section. Each rule adds a pilot restriction when its condition holds. Conditions: answer (a reference-set question id with the values that trigger), evidence_missing (a framework with no active record; only when the framework is in the agent's domain preset), identity_tier_min, protocol (status per protocol). Restrictions are advice for a bounded pilot, never a verdict.

rules.restriction: Keep a human approval gate outside the agent — pull-request review or action confirmation — for every write and command during the pilot.
Pilot with scoped, short-lived tokens only; keep production secrets out of the agent's environment.
Treat it as a hosted processor: data-flow review and a signed DPA before any private data is in scope.
Limit the pilot to one non-production repository with a protected default branch; let the agent push to one branch only.
Keep PHI and PII out of pilot inputs, or apply your own redaction before the agent sees a record.
Confirm in contract that customer data is excluded from model training before the pilot starts.
Keep the agent advisory: no automated claim decisions or system writes during the pilot.
Log inputs and outputs on your side; the vendor's audit trail is not documented.
Confirm the processing region in writing before personal data of EU or UK residents is in scope.
Confirm the publisher before procurement: no marketplace listing or ARD/A2A card ties this agent to the vendor's domain.
Do not wire it in over MCP until the server card validates.
Ask for the SOC 2 report under NDA before the pilot touches customer data; none was found in the sources checked.
No PHI in the pilot until a HIPAA BAA is in hand; no HIPAA evidence was found in the sources checked.
